author: KobeissiLetter
text:
BREAKING: Ukraine fired one of its largest drone attacks ever, estimated to include 1,600+ drones, targeting the Moscow region and hitting the city's main oil refinery.

This comes just 6 days after President Trump said Ukraine and Russia agreed not to hit energy targets in an effort to lower diesel prices.

The site that was struck supplies more than 33% of the Moscow region's fuel and is currently on fire.

Oil markets are set to open in 10 hours.
